study: Native packet-action JEPA with commitment and cumulative-excess confirmation
conditions: Odd seeds use existing hidden drift; even seeds stationary. Existing warehouse CAD family only.
training_robots: Repeat 24,24,100,100 by site index, balancing stationary/drifting conditions at both densities; validation always 100
pilot_amendment: Before any fitting/development/holdout access, exclude the TTL-ten pilot, align forced-action expiry to runtime, remove density/drift parity confounding, and sample both early and mature delivered-history states. Preserve original pilot source/data unchanged.
training_focus: Two lowest observable current pilot margins and two uniformly selected other available robots; no future label selection
validation_focus: Four uniformly selected available robots; preserve naturally occurring label imbalance
candidates: Up to three: two highest observed completed-scan AP margins and one uniformly chosen other observed AP; exclude current and unknown APs. Fewer available candidates/robots remain fewer, never invent an observation.
fork_fidelity: Exact cloned native packet state, full-duration exogenous draws, packet RNG, pending queues, scans, telemetry, forecast FIFO and controller. Branches share the same factual prefix and original draw duration. One focal robot stays or proposes one switch with the SAME one-second expiry as runtime, then holds its association for the ten-second label window; all other robots remain live. Branch telemetry evolves independently after the fork. The superseded TTL-ten pilot is preserved separately and excluded.
labels: Actual post-fork incremental missed command count switch minus stay, and branch-window maximum silence difference in seconds, including already-pending packets. Future observable local context from the switch branch is the JEPA EMA target. Hidden state never enters runtime features.
diagnostic_gate: Before fitting, publish positive/negative/zero delta counts by physical cost, label spread, exact factual replay and forced-action checks. If either cost has no beneficial observed action in training, stop and report insufficient decision evidence rather than claim success from an all-stay classifier.
model: Identical 23860-parameter inference graphs for JEPA and supervised ablation; JEPA alone adds masked EMA future-latent training and variance regularisation. Both predict packet action costs, not field reconstruction. Shared RadioMap route forecasts provide public physics features: this is an assisted packet-JEPA study, not a standalone JEPA claim.
checkpoint_selection: Each seed's lowest validation robust packet-count error plus five times gap error; all three fitted seeds evaluated, no winning-seed selection
calibration: Validation-only 95th percentile of actual delta-misses minus predicted mean, separately by method/seed and physical cost. Controller uses this empirical one-sided correction as a heuristic, not a proven conditional risk bound.
controller: One shared ten-second macro-action controller for JEPA, supervised and RadioMap numeric action values. Require known completed-scan candidate margin >=3 dB over NIST MCS0 99% threshold and >=current pilot margin-3 dB. Accept only corrected predicted switch-minus-stay loss <-1 command. Commit both stay and switch choices for at least ten seconds; executed switches reset that minimum from execution. No further focal handover occurs inside a ten-second label window. Proposals and pending cadence moves expire one second after the original issue. Track each accepted risk reservation and known switch exposure once. Native fast link/MCS control continues. Reservations do not guarantee factual regret. Canonical RadioMap with the prior common admission policy is a secondary reference.
timing: Seal prior-plus-new full RadioMap forecast p95 and local decision-head p95 before development. RadioMap receives its actual numeric-head cost. Matched neural architectures use the larger of their measured head costs. Head proposals are invisible before their own FIFO completion; origin-AP mismatch, scans and outages invalidate execution.
confirmation_arms: All three JEPA seeds, all three supervised seeds, common-controller RadioMap and canonical RadioMap: eight arms per site/cost, 128 runs
primary: JEPA minus common-controller RadioMap AND JEPA minus matched supervised terminal cumulative missed-command rate at BOTH physical costs; all four crossed site/training-seed bootstrap 95% upper endpoints must be below zero. No model- or cost-specific cherry-picking.
secondary: Canonical RadioMap comparison; maximum observed positive cumulative excess; final-third excess rate; worst-decile robot rate; maximum and p99 silence; throughput and compute; every trained seed separately
promotion_veto: Any harmful primary cost interval rejects broad promotion. At either cost a worse observed global maximum silence or mean worst-decile robot loss versus either common RadioMap or matched supervised aggregate vetoes promotion. Report final-third excess intervals and maximum positive observed cumulative excess separately; these do not establish a universal nonaccumulation guarantee. Raw absolute losses remain visible; never subtract a fixed scan floor. Physical deployment remains unqualified.
